description: Bunny's Limited is a Pakistani bakery business making bread and bun products. It was established in Lahore in 1984 by Mr. Younus Shafique Ch. and has grown from a small start into a supplier of bakery products to cities across Pakistan and internationally. The company also co-manufactures and packages products for PepsiCo.
sourceNote: Company website (bunnys.com.pk: about-us, contact-us), read 2026-10-17. The site names Lahore as the factory location but does not publish a full street address or telephone number.
